tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring lighter on a plane?

travelTips: You can bring one common lighter (Bic or Zippo style) on your person or in carry-on baggage. Torch lighters are prohibited.

faq.question: Is lighter allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Lighter is allowed in carry-on luggage. You can bring one common lighter (Bic or Zippo style) on your person or in carry-on baggage. Torch lighters are prohibited.

faq.question: Can you pack lighter in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Lighter is not allowed in checked bags. Lighters are prohibited in checked baggage unless empty of fuel or stored in a DOT-approved case.

faq.question: Can I bring a Bic lighter on Ryanair and TSA flights?
faq.answer: Yes! One standard disposable or Bic lighter is allowed ON YOUR PERSON through security on TSA and European flights (like Ryanair). Lighters with fuel are strictly banned in checked bags.

faq.question: Are torch lighters allowed on planes?
faq.answer: No. Torch lighters (blue flame / jet lighters) are strictly prohibited in both carry-on and checked luggage.
